argv:
import json
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

launcher = Path('todo.py').resolve()

def run(state, *args):
    p = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, str(launcher), '--file', str(state), *args],
        text=True,
        capture_output=True,
    )
    assert p.returncode == 0, (args, p.returncode, p.stdout, p.stderr)
    return p.stdout

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
    state = Path(td) / 'sequence.json'
    assert 'Added todo 1' in run(state, 'add', 'Prepare release notes')
    assert 'Added todo 2' in run(state, 'add', 'Run integration checks')
    assert 'Completed todo 1' in run(state, 'done', '1')
    assert 'Added todo 3' in run(state, 'add', 'Ship v2: docs & tests')

    listing = run(state, 'list')
    expected = [
        '[x] 1 Prepare release notes',
        '[ ] 2 Run integration checks',
        '[ ] 3 Ship v2: docs & tests',
    ]
    positions = [listing.index(line) for line in expected]
    assert positions == sorted(positions), listing

    stats = run(state, 'stats')
    assert 'Total: 3' in stats, stats
    assert 'Completed: 1' in stats, stats
    assert 'Pending: 2' in stats, stats

    document = json.loads(state.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    candidates = []
    if isinstance(document, list):
        candidates.append(document)
    elif isinstance(document, dict):
        candidates.extend(value for value in document.values() if isinstance(value, list))
    todos = next(
        value for value in candidates
        if len(value) == 3 and all(isinstance(item, dict) for item in value)
    )
    assert [item['id'] for item in todos] == [1, 2, 3]
    assert all(type(item['id']) is int for item in todos)
    assert [item['text'] for item in todos] == [
        'Prepare release notes',
        'Run integration checks',
        'Ship v2: docs & tests',
    ]
    assert [item['completed'] for item in todos] == [True, False, False]
    assert all(type(item['completed']) is bool for item in todos)

import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

launcher = Path('todo.py').resolve()

def invoke(*args):
    return subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, str(launcher), *args],
        text=True,
        capture_output=True,
    )

for args in [(), ('does-not-exist',)]:
    result = invoke(*args)
    combined = result.stdout + result.stderr
    assert result.returncode != 0, (args, combined)
    assert combined.strip(), args
    assert 'traceback' not in combined.lower(), combined
    assert 'usage' in combined.lower() or 'error' in combined.lower(), combined

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
    state = Path(td) / 'ids.json'
    added = invoke('--file', str(state), 'add', 'Still pending')
    assert added.returncode == 0, (added.stdout, added.stderr)

    for value in ('0', '-7'):
        result = invoke('--file', str(state), 'done', value)
        combined = result.stdout + result.stderr
        assert result.returncode != 0, (value, combined)
        assert 'traceback' not in combined.lower(), combined
        assert 'Completed todo' not in combined, combined

    listed = invoke('--file', str(state), 'list')
    assert listed.returncode == 0, (listed.stdout, listed.stderr)
    assert '[ ] 1 Still pending' in listed.stdout, listed.stdout
    assert '[x] 1 Still pending' not in listed.stdout, listed.stdout
